title: Trial on the Effect of Optically Modified Fiber Mattress Covers on Sleep Disturbances in Patients With Chronic Back Pain

sections.abstract:
Sleep quantity and quality can be influenced by the type of mattress used. This study is being done to see if a mattress cover with optically active particles can help back pain and improve sleep quality.

Posted outcomes: Optically Modified Polyethylene Terephthalate Fiber Mattress Cover (OMPETFMC) Improves Sleep Quality in Patients With Lower Back Pain as Measured by Clinical Gl. timeframe=14 days. Mean CGI Pain Scores With Placebo Mattress Cover.=4.07 (±1.27); Mean CGI Pain Scores With Active Mattress Cover.=3.86 (±1.10); Mean CGI Sleep Scores With Placebo Mattress Cover.=3.93 (±1.27)
